tasks.short: Confer with underwriters to resolve a mortgage application problem.

steps.what: Assemble the underwriting condition, application facts, valuation, income evidence and prior messages
Discuss the condition with the underwriter, clarify evidence and agree the next case action
Record the agreed condition response and assign the next evidence request

tasks.design: A {CRM} condition view assembles the exact mortgage evidence and prior messages before the call. The officer and underwriter resolve the condition together; the {WORKFLOW} records the agreed next action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each person reconstructs the mortgage case from attachments and notes before discussing it.
tasks.enabler_now: A case view can bring condition, evidence and ownership into one dossier.
tasks.still_hard: An underwriter's risk concern and a credible response to it require a professional conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can explain the applicant's circumstances and negotiate a practical evidence path.

ambition.what: Review the daily queue of mortgage conditions that have been waiting for a named owner.

tasks.altitude: The officer identifies recurring condition causes and improves application preparation.

reach.task: State an evidence condition that is specific and testable
reach.learn: Distinguish a missing fact from an unresolved risk judgement.

evidence.claim: A case workflow can assemble source-linked evidence while resolution remains human judgement.

assumptions: The boundary starts with an underwriting condition and ends with a recorded next action, not an underwriting approval.
The condition contract contains case ID, condition text, evidence IDs, document versions, owner, due date, response and status; the underwriter supplies the condition.
A conflicting or missing source stays open for manual investigation.
Native case views and task routing are tested before custom code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for dossier-field and routing maintenance.
unknowns: Which mortgage conditions recur most often.
Which evidence sources the underwriter can access directly.
research_questions: How long do open underwriting conditions wait?
Which condition types are resolved without a second call?

incremental.description: Maintain condition dossier fields and task routes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The resolution conversation remains the main work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Contact applicants or creditors to resolve questions and complete paperwork.

steps.what: Identify the question, missing form fields and documents from the application or creditor request

loop.input: message, application fields and submitted paperwork
loop.output: question category and targeted missing-paperwork checklist
loop.check: the officer checks the account match, requested field and document version
loop.stop: stop on unclear identity, conflicting instruction or a request outside authority; call the case owner
loop.why_not_simpler: Messages use varied language and may concern a particular document or account exception.

steps.what: Contact the applicant or creditor, explain the question and help complete the required paperwork
Update the application checklist and create the next follow-up reminder

tasks.design: A {CRM} checklist identifies the field or document at issue before a contact. The loan officer has the conversation and the {WORKFLOW} retains the stated requirement and next follow-up.
tasks.previous_blocker: The officer reads the request, searches the application and re-enters the same missing item after the call.
tasks.enabler_now: Application fields and checklist state can be combined with a bounded classification of the incoming question.
tasks.still_hard: A person may be confused, worried or unable to supply a document without a responsive explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can explain why a field matters and find a workable way to complete the paperwork.

ambition.what: Give applicants with an incomplete form a precise, understandable next step rather than a generic missing-document message.

tasks.altitude: The officer improves unclear forms and common question guidance instead of repeatedly diagnosing missing fields.

reach.task: Clarify a required application field and record the result
reach.learn: Use a checklist without assuming the customer's question is routine.

evidence.claim: A bounded classification can prepare a reviewable question summary, while live paperwork assistance remains human work.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a question about an application and ends with an updated checklist, not an eligibility decision.
The contact contract contains case ID, requester identity, question category, required field, document version, contact outcome and follow-up date; the request and case record provide the fields.
An identity mismatch or unclear authority is handled manually before any account detail is discussed.
Native CRM checklist and reminder features are tested before custom workflow code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for category and checklist maintenance.
unknowns: Which paperwork fields cause the most contacts.
Whether creditors use a secure channel for document questions.
research_questions: Which question categories lead to a second contact?
What share of paperwork can be completed during the first call?

incremental.description: Maintain question categories and checklist rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live paperwork assistance remains most of the work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Contact delinquent borrowers to obtain payment or negotiate a repayment plan.

steps.what: Prepare the borrower contact brief with overdue amount, payment history, prior promises and exception markers
Speak with the borrower about the missed payment, circumstances and realistic repayment options
Record the commitment, promised payment date or requested plan and schedule follow-up

tasks.design: A {CRM} contact brief presents the dated account facts and exception markers before the call. The officer conducts the repayment conversation and a {WORKFLOW} records the explicit commitment or routes a plan request.
tasks.previous_blocker: The officer compiles balance, notes and prior contacts immediately before every borrower call.
tasks.enabler_now: Dated account facts and prior commitments can be assembled without deciding how the borrower should be treated.
tasks.still_hard: Hardship, trust and whether an arrangement is sustainable need a careful human conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can listen for a change in circumstances and agree an action the borrower actually understands.

ambition.what: Offer borrowers who cannot pay in full a clear human route to discuss a repayment-plan request.

tasks.altitude: The officer examines why commitments fail and improves contact timing and plan rules.

reach.task: Assess whether a requested repayment plan is sustainable
reach.learn: Separate an account balance from a borrower's current circumstances.

evidence.claim: A workflow can assemble account facts and record a commitment, while repayment negotiation remains human judgement.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a delinquent account ready for contact and ends with a recorded borrower commitment or plan request, not a collection action.

The contact contract contains account ID, overdue amount, payment history, contact attempt, exception marker, promised amount, promised date, requested plan and follow-up owner; the account record supplies the factual fields.
A dispute, hardship marker or vulnerability concern is routed to the appropriate human process before a standard contact path.
Native account notes and follow-up features are tested before custom workflow code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for contact-brief fields and exception-rule maintenance.
unknowns: Which repayment-plan terms the officer may discuss without approval.
Which vulnerability and hardship processes apply to borrower contact.
research_questions: What share of borrowers keep the first promised payment?
Which exception markers lead to a specialist referral?

incremental.description: Maintain contact-brief fields and exception rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The borrower conversation remains the core work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel clients on personal and family financial problems.

steps.what: Prepare the client's stated concern, known commitments and agreed prior actions for a counselling conversation
Listen to the client's spending or borrowing concern and explore options without making unsupported assumptions
Record agreed next actions and provide an appropriate referral or follow-up resource

loop.input: agreed actions and approved support resources
loop.output: plain-language action note with resource links
loop.check: the officer checks that the note reflects the conversation and that resources are appropriate and current
loop.stop: stop when the client needs specialist debt, welfare or safeguarding support; make a human referral
loop.why_not_simpler: The note has a structure, but the client's situation and appropriate support require a human reading.

tasks.design: A {CRM} brief avoids asking the client to repeat known facts and a bounded draft prepares the agreed support note. The officer owns the counselling conversation, its limits and any referral to specialist support.
tasks.previous_blocker: Officers search past notes before counselling and rewrite action notes after an emotionally demanding conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Known factual context can be prepared and an agreed action note can be drafted from the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Financial distress, family circumstances and appropriate specialist support cannot be safely resolved by an automated recommendation.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can build trust, recognise distress and adapt the pace and next step to the client.

ambition.what: Give clients who disclose financial difficulty a clear, human-agreed support note and referral path.

tasks.altitude: The officer spots recurring barriers to repayment and improves referral knowledge without turning counselling into a scripted decision.

reach.task: Assess when a client needs specialist debt support
reach.learn: Recognise the boundary between a lending conversation and a wider debt problem.

evidence.claim: Context preparation and a bounded draft can reduce rekeying, while counselling remains human work.

assumptions: The boundary starts with a client asking for help and ends with an agreed support note or specialist referral, not a binding financial plan.
The counselling contract contains client ID, stated concern, known commitments, agreed action, referral type, consent state, owner and follow-up date; the client and officer provide the content.
A safeguarding, severe hardship or specialist-debt concern is referred to a human service rather than handled by the draft.
Native CRM notes and task features are tested before custom drafting.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for resource-list review and exceptional referral handling.
unknowns: Which local debt and welfare services are approved referral options.
What training and boundaries apply to loan-officer counselling.
research_questions: Which concerns most often lead to a specialist referral?
How often do clients complete the agreed follow-up action?

already_counted.description: Officer review of drafted support note

incremental.description: Review referral resources and exceptional cases

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The counselling conversation remains the core work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

role.altitude: Run a daily exception review across incomplete applications, credit evidence and authority routes.
reach: personal financial advisor: recognise when an applicant needs broader budgeting or debt advice
role.ambitious_version: Give more applicants a complete, understandable path from enquiry to an accountable lending decision.
